_meta.description: Curated list of fintech / SCF platform failures and acquisitions that left banks orphaned. Used as Signal 3 in the Buying Intent Score. Severity reflects urgency of replacement need.
_meta.severity_scale: critical (urgent replacement, <6mo) | moderate (6-18mo window) | low (information only)

replaced_by.approach: Direct SCF program rollout to Greensill orphans
Aggressive expansion post-SAP acquisition (Mar 2022) into post-Greensill space

affected_banks.status: exited SCF, then UBS-acquired 2023 — not addressable

events.verbatim_evidence: Greensill Capital filed for insolvency on 8 March 2021, leaving Credit Suisse with USD 10bn frozen in supply chain finance funds. Most orphaned corporate accounts were eventually re-served by JPMorgan and Taulia (post-SAP acquisition) over 2024-2025 — a 3-4 year gap closure timeline.
events.source: FT (8/3/2021), Bloomberg, multiple press; Taulia/SAP acquisition (3/2022); JPM expansion 2024-2025
events.credable_implication: ★★★ POWERFUL PITCH ARGUMENT: 'When a fintech fails, banks live with the gap for 3-4 years (2021 Greensill → 2024-2025 JPM/Taulia replacement). Don't let your bank wait 3 years for a vague successor. CredAble deploys in 3-6 months.' Use this as the urgency lever for any orphan / fintech-failure-adjacent prospect (notably Roger orphans, we.trade orphans).
events.pitch_argument: Le gap d'attente après faillite fintech est historiquement de 3-4 ans (Greensill 2021 → JPM/Taulia 2024-25). CredAble offre une réponse en 3-6 mois — éviter à la banque ce gap qui aurait coûté jusqu'à 4 années de programmes SCF perdus.

affected_banks.exposure: 25% stake in Roger via KB SmartSolutions

events.verbatim_evidence: Orbian acquires Czech supply chain finance fintech Roger. KB SmartSolutions divested its 25% stake.
events.source: GTR (5/2/2025) — 'Orbian acquires Czech supply chain finance fintech Roger'
events.credable_implication: URGENT: Komerční banka has no SCF tech partner and observable corporate demand (cited by Stellantis, Siemens). 6-month window to position CredAble as Roger replacement.

events.verbatim_evidence: we.trade shut down June 2022 after failing to attract sufficient corporate users for its blockchain-based open account trade platform. 12 founding banks lost their joint venture investment.
events.credable_implication: Most affected banks have moved on, but KBC reportedly still seeks SCF tech replacement for KBC Commercial Finance. Indirect signal: banks are wary of consortium / blockchain SCF — receptive to proven white-label alternatives.

events.verbatim_evidence: Marco Polo Network filed for insolvency March 2022 after burning through funding for blockchain-based trade finance network.
events.credable_implication: Documentary trade tech orphans. Commerzbank in particular observed declining capability. Receptive to documentary-trade-focused white-label.

events.verbatim_evidence: HSBC announces JV with Tradeshift, takes majority stake, integrates SCF platform globally.
events.credable_implication: HSBC effectively removed from prospect pool. But this validates the white-label B2B SCF model market existence. Other banks may follow (FOMO signal for peers).

events.verbatim_evidence: FundThrough pivoted from B2B bank partnerships to direct invoice factoring for SMEs.
events.credable_implication: Reduced competition in bank white-label space.

_observations.trend: Greensill collapse triggered a 3-year reset in European bank-SCF partnerships. The market is now more receptive to proven, multi-vendor, non-blockchain white-label platforms — exactly CredAble's positioning.

_master_pitch_argument.title: The Replacement Gap — historically 3-4 years
_master_pitch_argument.body: Greensill collapsed in March 2021. JPMorgan and Taulia (post-SAP acquisition) only filled the void for affected banks/anchors during 2024-2025 — a 3-4 year gap. During this period, affected banks lost SCF program continuity, supplier relationships, and corporate fees. Roger (acquired by Orbian Feb 2025) creates a similar gap for Komerční banka today. The historical lesson: without a fast replacement decision, the gap closes only at year 3-4 by default vendors. CredAble's value proposition for any orphaned bank: deploy in 3-6 months instead of 3-4 years.
use_for: KBC + ČSOB + K&H (we.trade orphan, 3 years post) — closing window
Commerzbank (Marco Polo orphan) — past window but indirect signal
Any future fintech failure detected via trigger_engine
_master_pitch_argument.competitor_dynamic: JPMorgan and Taulia (SAP) became dominant post-Greensill replacements 2024-2025. CredAble must win orphans BEFORE these incumbents enter. Speed of pitch matters more than depth of features.
